emma_s: POC with BeaconCorp. trying to export logs+traces to Datadog. traces arrive but logs have trace:null and we hit 429s on export. any quick wins?
leo_ops: check if trace header is propagated from request -> worker. also inspect 429 response headers for Retry-After/X-RateLimit-Remaining.
nate_se: common leak: async jobs drop AsyncLocalStorage, logger reads context too early. Are you on node workers?
emma_s: yes node. sample header: `X-Traceparent: 00-8c7f2a-3333333333333333-01` and log: `{msg: "model out", trace: null, req_id: "abc123"}`
leo_ops: looks like trace id in traceparent is present but not passed into job meta. quick patch: carry trace into job payload and set logger field.
sales-eng: if we increase concurrency to avoid 429s will that affect POC cost? customer is price-sensitive.
leo_ops: increasing concurrency may increase request counts. better: batch exports (size 25), add backoff honoring Retry-After, and apply temporary quota bump for 12h if needed for demo.
infra-bot: detected export cluster 429 spike for org beaconcorp-42 at 15:12 UTC (limit 100/s -> 0 remaining).
nate_se: also ensure exporter maps our header to Datadog's `dd.trace_id`. i.e., exporter should set `span.trace_id` and include dd.trace_id on logs. if legacy req ids are 64-bit, pad to 128-bit hex.
emma_s: patching middleware to attach redwoodTrace and send with job. adding batching+retry. can someone flip a 12h quota bump while i test?
leo_ops: I can apply 12h override and will schedule auto-rollback. doing it now.
infra-bot: action: quota_override applied for beaconcorp-42 by leo_ops; expires in 12h.
emma_s: thanks — will validate correlation and check 429 recurrence. will report back in ~20m. :thumbsup:
